solubility is the calculation of the Flory–Huggins interaction parameter w. It is based on the Flory–Huggins thermodynamic theory, which accounts for the contribution of nonideal entropy to the system by adopting a lattice model to the polymer solution.<sup>15,16</sup> The Flory–Huggins interaction parameter arises as the energy change upon mixing, $\Delta \omega_{12},$ divided by RT, where R is the gas constant and T is the absolute temperature, as shown in eqn (1).17

We also compare the three approaches in terms of reproducing experimental values versus computational requirements. We select cyclohexane as the organic solvent due to its suitability for nonaqueous extraction processes.27
